title: TriAgent: code, instances and runs for the MEDES 2026 paper
description: Code, instances and all runs behind the MEDES 2026 paper "TriAgent: A three-layer LLM-based agentic framework for web-based process automation": the TriAgent implementation (Knowledge, Reasoning and Execution agents on LangGraph), the rule store, the production and tool-forcing datasets for five crop-disease processes, the scoring and analysis scripts, and the result files of every configuration (Gemma4-26B and Qwen3.6-27B over five seeds, DeepSeek-V3 single runs).
